candidates.content_text:
The Opportunity:
Maitland City Council's Pathways program is a fantastic way to kick-start your career and gain professional experience in local government!
Commencing in January 2027, for a period of two years, we have two exciting opportunities for Graduate Civil Engineers to join our organisation.
In this role, you will undertake a graduate program developed specifically for you, giving you exposure to a range of civil engineering functions for the investigation and delivery of civil and recreation infrastructure projects undertaken by Council. These duties are going to help you develop a solid foundation to your civil engineering career.
About you:
To be successful in this role you will possess:
- Degree level qualifications in Civil engineering in the previous two years or completion of degree by January 2027
- Contemporary industry knowledge of civil engineering areas
- Experience and understanding in project support and the research, analysis and presentation of information
- Current Class C driver's licence
Benefits:
This Graduate position is temporary full time (two-year contract) with a commencing salary of $1,414.58 weekly, plus 12% superannuation. Graduates will also have access to Council's great staff benefits including:
- Flexible work arrangements
- One extra week of "My Leave" a year (to use how you like!)
- Ongoing training and development
- Fitness Passport
- Healthy Employee Program
To apply:
To apply for this opportunity, please click 'Apply Now' and submit your resume and cover letter.
Questions:
To viw the role charter click 'Apply Now'. If after reading the role charter you have any questions, please contact the recruitment team at Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au
More information regarding Council's Pathways Program can be viewed via https://www.maitland.nsw.gov.au/pathways-program.
Applications close: Sunday 25th October 2027
Only candidates with current Australian work rights (Australian citizens, permanent residents, NZ citizens with a current passport, valid work visa) will be considered.
What happens next?
Once applications close, we will review all candidates' details against the role requirements and will be back in touch with you to advise the status of your application.
Please note, prior to an offer of employment being made, recommended candidates will be required to undertake a medical assessment (including drug and alcohol testing). Council also completes a range of other pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, psychometric testing or a criminal history check. For more information about the recruitment process, visit the "Jobs at Council" page on our website.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
Maitland City Council is dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive and supportive and is reflective of the diverse community we serve. We support equal opportunities for all employees, and encourage applications from people from all cultures, nationalities, identities, and abilities. We believe all employees have the right to feel valued, respected and heard. If you have any special considerations or accessibility requirements, please let us know in the recruitment process how we are able to meet your needs.
 If you require special assistance, or have any questions about the recruitment process please contact us for a confidential conversation (Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au)

About the role
Ground Civil is seeking an experienced Civil Designer to join our West Perth office, with strong experience in subdivision and land development design.
You will work on a variety of civil and land development projects across Western Australia, taking designs from initial concept through detailed design and authority approval. The role will suit a practical designer who is confident in Civil 3D and can work independently while collaborating closely with our engineering team.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare subdivision and land development designs using AutoCAD Civil 3D
- Design roads, earthworks, stormwater drainage, sewer and water infrastructure
- Prepare detailed design and construction drawings
- Develop Civil 3D surfaces, alignments, profiles, corridors and earthworks models
- Coordinate designs with surveyors, engineers and other consultants
- Assist with local government, Water Corporation and other authority approvals
- Respond to design review comments and coordinate amendments through to approval
- Ensure designs and documentation are accurate, practical and compliant with applicable standards
About you
- Demonstrated civil design experience in subdivision and land development
- Strong proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D
- Practical experience in road, drainage, earthworks and utility design
- Australian civil design experience
- WA subdivision and land development experience will be highly regarded
- Familiarity with WA approval processes and relevant authority requirements will be highly regarded
- Ability to work independently and manage design tasks efficiently
- Strong attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality construction documentation
- Good communication and coordination skills
Why join Ground Civil?
- Work directly on a diverse range of subdivision and land development projects
- Be involved across the design process rather than working on only one component
- Work closely with experienced engineers in our West Perth office
- Opportunity to take ownership of designs and develop broader project experience
- Professional and supportive small-team environment

candidates.content_text:
The Opportunity
Our client who is a first class civil engineering consultancy who is seeking a Graduate Civil Engineer to join their experienced Cairns-based engineering team.
This is an opportunity to apply your technical skills to projects that have a genuine impact, from roads that connect communities and drainage systems that protect property, through to bridges, culverts, water infrastructure and land development projects.
This consultancy provides civil engineering and project management services across government, private development, infrastructure and regional projects throughout Far North Queensland and beyond. Their project portfolio includes roads and drainage, water and wastewater infrastructure, subdivisions, bridge and crossing works, airports and major infrastructure projects.
The Role
You will be a hands-on member of the engineering team, contributing to the planning, design and delivery of a broad range of civil infrastructure projects.
This is more than producing drawings and technical reports. You will see projects progress from concept and design through to construction and completion, working alongside experienced engineers, clients, contractors and other stakeholders.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing practical and cost-effective civil infrastructure designs
- Supporting road, drainage, stormwater, water and land development projects
- Preparing technical drawings, documentation and engineering reports
- Assisting with project delivery and undertaking site inspections
- Monitoring construction outcomes, quality and project requirements
- Identifying technical issues and developing practical solutions
- Supporting approvals, compliance and stakeholder requirements
- Liaising professionally with clients, contractors and project stakeholders
- Working closely with senior engineers while developing your technical capability
About You
You will be a motivated Civil Engineer who enjoys civil design, practical problem solving and wants exposure to a diverse range of projects.
You will ideally have:
- Degree qualification in Civil Engineering
- Practical experience in civil design is a must
- Exposure to roads, drainage, stormwater, water, subdivisions or similar projects
- Strong technical and problem-solving skills
- Good attention to detail and an ability to manage competing priorities
- Clear written and verbal communication skills
- A practical approach to engineering and project delivery
- Current driver's licence and willingness to attend project sites
This role could suit an early-career Civil Engineer looking to build broader consulting experience, or an Engineer with several years of experience seeking greater project variety and responsibility.
Why Join This Engineering Consultancy?
They offer the opportunity to work alongside experienced Civil Engineers and project professionals on projects across both metropolitan and regional environments. The business places a strong emphasis on professional development, practical experience, integrity and delivering quality outcomes for its clients.
Job Offer
- $75,000 - $85,000 + super, negotiable based on experience
- Relocation assistance available
- Diverse civil projects from concept and design through to construction
- Exposure to roads, drainage, water, infrastructure and land development
- Hands-on project and site experience
- Mentoring from experienced senior engineers
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Opportunity to contribute ideas and influence project outcomes
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Long-term career stability and genuine project variety
How To Apply
To build your career with a company that values quality engineering, practical solutions and the work you deliver, please click Apply and please include any civil design experience you have undertaken in your application.
About Us
With Head Office in Cairns and offices in Townsville and Brisbane. We specialise in professional, administration, engineering and industrial recruitment, permanent and temporary placements for both commercial and government enterprise. We are proud to connect great people with meaningful careers.

Build More. Build Your Career.
Ready to kick-start your engineering career on some of Southeast Queensland’s most exciting infrastructure projects?
Seymour Whyte's Graduate Program gives ambitious engineering graduates the opportunity to work on major projects, take on real responsibility from day one, and develop the technical, commercial and leadership skills needed for a successful career in construction.
Through our structured two-year development program, you'll gain hands-on experience across major civil infrastructure projects, work alongside industry leaders, receive dedicated mentoring and build the skills and confidence to accelerate your career.  You'll be trusted with real responsibility, supported to grow and given the opportunity to make a genuine impact while helping deliver infrastructure that connects communities.
About the Project
We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Beerburrum to Nambour (B2N) Rail Upgrade project.
This a major infrastructure project transforming the North Coast Line on the Sunshine Coast. The project includes rail duplication, new and upgraded transport infrastructure, improved road overpasses and enhanced signalling systems, all aimed at increasing capacity and reliability across the network. Once complete, B2N will deliver faster and more efficient travel while improving connections between the Sunshine Coast, Moreton Bay and Brisbane, creating lasting benefits for local communities and the region.
Why Join Seymour Whyte?
At Seymour Whyte, we believe the best way to learn is by doing. Our structured Graduate Development Program is designed to fast-track your career through hands-on project experience, mentoring from industry leaders and tailored professional development opportunities.
From day one, you'll be embedded in a live project team, contributing to the delivery of major infrastructure projects that shape communities across Australia. You'll gain exposure to a range of disciplines, build your technical and commercial acumen and develop the confidence to take ownership of meaningful work early in your career.
Throughout the program, you'll be supported by experienced mentors, participate in structured development workshops, and connect with a national network of graduates and professionals who are invested in your success.
What's in it for you?
- Work on a landmark civil infrastructure project from day one
- Gain exposure to multiple disciplines across project delivery
- Receive structured mentoring, coaching and development support
- Learn from experienced industry leaders and subject matter experts
- Build a strong professional network across projects and regions
- Be part of a collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture
- Access career opportunities within the VINCI Group, a global leader in construction, infrastructure and concessions
Whether your passion lies in construction delivery, engineering, project management or leadership, our Graduate Development Program will provide the foundation, support and opportunities to help you build a rewarding and long-term career with Seymour Whyte.
To learn more about our Graduate Program, click here.
About You
You're in your final year of a Bachelor of Civil Engineering and ready to turn everything you've learned into real-world experience on major infrastructure projects.
Whether you've gained experience through an internship, vacation work, industry placement or part-time employment, you're eager to learn, build your skills and make a meaningful contribution from day one.
We're looking for graduates who are curious, motivated and excited about a career in civil construction.
You'll bring:
- Final-year studies in a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Practical experience through internships, vacation programs, placements or other employment
- A genuine passion for civil construction and infrastructure projects
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced industry professionals
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to safety, collaboration and creating a positive team culture
- Flexibility to travel or relocate as opportunities arise throughout your career
Most importantly, you're ready to take the next step, embrace new challenges and build a rewarding career delivering projects that make a lasting impact on communities across Australia.
Seymour Whyte Benefits
- Employee recognition and awards that celebrate contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long-term success of the business
- Birthday leave, because celebrating life's milestones matters
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or personal commitments
- Fitness and wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym memberships, meal plans and fitness brands)
- Travel, retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial savings through CommBank and Flare
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.
Next Steps:
- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia
To learn more about us, visit www.seymourwhyte.com.au

candidates.content_text:
Build More. Build Your Career.
Ready to kick-start your engineering career on some of Southeast Queensland’s most exciting infrastructure projects?
Seymour Whyte's Graduate Program gives ambitious engineering graduates the opportunity to work on major projects, take on real responsibility from day one, and develop the technical, commercial and leadership skills needed for a successful career in construction.
Through our structured two-year development program, you'll gain hands-on experience across major civil infrastructure projects, work alongside industry leaders, receive dedicated mentoring and build the skills and confidence to accelerate your career.  You'll be trusted with real responsibility, supported to grow and given the opportunity to make a genuine impact while helping deliver infrastructure that connects communities.
If you're ready to learn, grow and help shape the future, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Project
Join the team delivering the Coomera Connector Stage 1 South, a landmark transport infrastructure project that will transform connectivity between Logan City and the Gold Coast.
As a Graduate Civil Engineer, you'll gain hands-on experience working on a major project that will provide a vital alternative to the M1 Pacific Motorway, helping support the region's continued growth for generations to come.
Working alongside experienced industry professionals, you'll be exposed to a diverse range of construction activities, including major earthworks, bridge construction and complex environmental initiatives. A key feature of the project is the delivery of a 300-metre bridge over the Nerang River, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to a project of significant scale and complexity.
This is your chance to take on meaningful responsibility, develop your technical capabilities, and build a strong foundation for a successful career in civil construction while helping deliver infrastructure that makes a lasting impact on Queensland communities.
Why Join Seymour Whyte?
At Seymour Whyte, we believe the best way to learn is by doing. Our structured Graduate Development Program is designed to fast-track your career through hands-on project experience, mentoring from industry leaders and tailored professional development opportunities.
From day one, you'll be embedded in a live project team, contributing to the delivery of major infrastructure projects that shape communities across Australia. You'll gain exposure to a range of disciplines, build your technical and commercial acumen and develop the confidence to take ownership of meaningful work early in your career.
Throughout the program, you'll be supported by experienced mentors, participate in structured development workshops, and connect with a national network of graduates and professionals who are invested in your success.
What's in it for you?
- Work on a landmark civil infrastructure project from day one
- Gain exposure to multiple disciplines across project delivery
- Receive structured mentoring, coaching and development support
- Learn from experienced industry leaders and subject matter experts
- Build a strong professional network across projects and regions
- Be part of a collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture
- Access career opportunities within the VINCI Group, a global leader in construction, infrastructure and concessions
Whether your passion lies in construction delivery, engineering, project management or leadership, our Graduate Development Program will provide the foundation, support and opportunities to help you build a rewarding and long-term career with Seymour Whyte.
To learn more about our Graduate Program, click here.
About You
You're in your final year of a Bachelor of Civil Engineering and ready to turn everything you've learned into real-world experience on major infrastructure projects.
Whether you've gained experience through an internship, vacation work, industry placement or part-time employment, you're eager to learn, build your skills and make a meaningful contribution from day one.
We're looking for graduates who are curious, motivated and excited about a career in civil construction.
You'll bring:
- Final-year studies in a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Practical experience through internships, vacation programs, placements or other employment
- A genuine passion for civil construction and infrastructure projects
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced industry professionals
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to safety, collaboration and creating a positive team culture
- Flexibility to travel or relocate as opportunities arise throughout your career
Most importantly, you're ready to take the next step, embrace new challenges, and build a rewarding career delivering projects that make a lasting impact on communities across Australia.
Seymour Whyte Benefits
- Employee recognition and awards that celebrate contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long-term success of the business
- Birthday leave, because celebrating life's milestones matters
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or personal commitments
- Fitness and wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym memberships, meal plans and fitness brands)
- Travel, retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial savings through CommBank and Flare
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.
Next Steps:
- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia
To learn more about us, visit www.seymourwhyte.com.au

candidates.content_text:
City of Armadale
Armadale, Perth WA
Engineering – Civil/Structural Engineering 
$102,000–$117,000 per annum plus superannuation
Shape a growing City’s infrastructure. Plan capital projects through design, costing and approvals, with WFH and flexi-time for a 9-day fortnight.
 -  Shape infrastructure projects across asset renewal, upgrades and growth.
 -  Flexible working with WFH and accrued flexi-time towards a 9-day fortnight.
 -  Superannuation up to 15%, subject to conditions, plus free gym membership.
 Help shape the projects that shape our City
Good infrastructure starts with good decisions. Understanding what is needed, testing the options and resolving the detail before construction begins.
At the City of Armadale, you’ll help make those decisions. As one of Western Australia’s fastest-growing local governments, we’re planning new infrastructure while improving and renewing the assets our community already relies on.
We’re looking for a Project Planning Engineer who brings practical judgement, asks good questions and takes pride in preparing projects properly.
If you’re enjoying your current role but would welcome the opportunity to influence a growing City’s infrastructure, this could be your next move.
Why Armadale?
Our Strategic Community Plan sets a clear direction: facilities that meet community needs, better public places, and infrastructure that is functional, inclusive and sustainable.
You’ll help turn those priorities into practical projects, balancing technical requirements, cost, risk and long-term asset performance. Across renewal, upgrade and growth projects, you’ll tackle varied challenges and see how your work contributes to the community.
You’ll also have flexibility in how you work, including working from home and the ability to accrue flexi-time to work a nine-day fortnight, with arrangements agreed around role and team requirements.
Your role
Working in our Asset Planning team, reporting to the Project Planning Lead, you’ll progress identified infrastructure priorities into well-defined, costed and approved capital projects ready for delivery.
Starting with Project Initiation Documents developed by Strategic Asset Management, you’ll coordinate investigations and detailed designs, refine cost estimates and progress the approvals needed for capital works program entry.
You’ll work with engineering and landscape design specialists, consultants, asset operators and delivery teams to:
 - Develop clear project scopes, specifications and budget requirements.
 - Coordinate investigations, technical advice and detailed design activities.
 - Prepare and refine cost estimates, checking assumptions, contingencies and constructability.
 - Progress approvals, utility clearances, statutory consents and other project requirements.
 - Prepare complete project packages for review under the City’s Project Management Framework.
 - Resolve risks and gaps early, considering procurement, construction sequencing and handover requirements.
Your work will help the City make informed investment decisions and give delivery teams confidence in each project’s scope, cost and readiness.
What you’ll bring
You know what it takes to prepare an infrastructure project for delivery. You can work through technical detail, challenge assumptions constructively and bring the right people together to resolve issues.
We’re looking for:
 - Tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management or a closely related discipline**, or equivalent demonstrated experience in project planning and infrastructure development.
 - Experience planning civil infrastructure or construction projects.
 - Sound knowledge of cost estimation, contingency allowances and key cost drivers.
 - The ability to coordinate technical input across disciplines and progress third-party approvals.
 - Familiarity with project management frameworks and project approval requirements.
Flexibility and benefits
 - Working-from-home arrangements and flexi-time, including the ability to accrue time towards a nine-day fortnight.
 - Superannuation contributions of up to 15%, subject to employee contributions and applicable conditions.
 - Free Armadale Fitness and Aquatic Centre membership**, including the gym, pools, sauna and group fitness classes.
 - Wellbeing activities throughout the year.
 - Novated leasing opportunities.
Our values—Care; Are Better, Together; Learn & Grow; and Seize Today, Shape Tomorrow—guide how we work. We listen, share knowledge and welcome people who bring ideas and take responsibility for their work.
Interested? Let’s talk
You don’t need to be actively looking for a new job to explore this opportunity.
For an initial confidential conversation, contact People Services on 9394 5189 or hr@armadale.wa.gov.au. 
Ready to apply? Submit your CV and a brief cover letter through the application link, outlining your relevant experience and interest in the role.
We review applications as they are received and may close the advertisement early.
*The City of Armadale welcomes applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, people from culturally diverse backgrounds and people of all genders and identities.*
*We are committed to child safety and recruitment practices that support a safe and inclusive community.*

We work closely with clients, contractors and delivery partners to develop solutions that perform both on paper and in the field.

Working alongside experienced engineers and design managers, you'll play a key role in delivering documentation across a diverse portfolio that includes:
- Roads and highways
- Civil infrastructure
- Renewable energy projects
- Drainage and earthworks
- Buildings and associated civil works
- Temporary and permanent works
You will also have the opportunity to broaden your skillset into structural drafting and help drive the adoption of AI-enabled drafting workflows and automation tools.
What You'll Be Doing
- Producing civil and structural engineering drawings using Bentley MicroStation
- Managing project documentation and workflows in ProjectWise
- Coordinating drawing production across multidisciplinary teams
- Assisting with document control and drawing management
- Leading CAD standards, drafting efficiency and quality processes
- Exploring and implementing AI tools to improve drafting productivity, consistency and quality
- Structural drafting where required
About You
We're looking for someone who has:
Essential
- Strong experience using Bentley MicroStation and/or OpenRoads Designer
- Strong experience using and managing ProjectWise
- Experience drafting civil infrastructure projects in Victoria, particularly on major projects
- Excellent attention to detail and drawing presentation
- Strong understanding of engineering documentation standards
- Ability to work collaboratively within a project team
- Strong communication and organisational skills
Desirable
- Experience with OpenRoads Designer
- Experience with renewable energy projects
- Structural drafting experience
- Interest in automation, digital engineering and AI tools
- Experience working in ISO-aligned quality environments
- Experience in training and managing other drafters
Why Join Hullcon?
- Work directly with senior engineers and project leaders
- Exposure to major transport and renewable energy projects
- Genuine opportunity to shape how AI is used within engineering design
- Diverse project portfolio with technical challenges and variety
- Collaborative, office-based environment focused on mentoring and development
- Growing consultancy with significant opportunities for career progression
- Competitive salary package based on experience
Apply
If you're a skilled MicroStation Draftsperson looking to work on meaningful projects and are excited by the future of AI-enabled engineering design, we'd love to hear from you.
This is an office-based role with a minimum requirement of 3 days per week in the office.
Apply via SEEK with your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your Bentley MicroStation and ProjectWise experience. Only applicants with predominant Bentley experience will be considered.

About the role
Duffy Kennedy Constructions (DKC) is seeking an experienced and motivated Civil Engineering Draftsperson to join our team in Miranda, NSW. This full-time position plays an important role in supporting our ongoing construction projects by preparing accurate technical drawings, coordinating design documentation, and providing timely drafting support to project managers and site teams. The successful candidate will work closely with our design and construction teams, contributing to the efficient delivery of residential, commercial and other building projects.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare and amend detailed civil and structural engineering drawings using AutoCAD, Revit or other relevant drafting software.
- Produce technical drawings for earthworks, drainage systems, foundations, reinforced concrete elements and other construction components.
- Interpret engineering calculations, design specifications and technical sketches to develop accurate construction drawings and documentation.
- Review and update drawings to reflect design changes, construction requirements and actual site conditions.
- Conduct site visits when required to verify construction details, identify discrepancies and assist with drawing revisions.
- Liaise with engineers, estimators, project managers and subcontractors to ensure drawings meet project requirements and relevant Australian Standards.
- Provide technical drafting support to construction teams and assist in resolving drawing-related issues during project execution.
- Maintain accurate drawing records, documentation and version control throughout the project lifecycle.
About you
- Relevant tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering, Engineering Drafting, Architectural Engineering or a related discipline.
- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in civil or structural engineering drafting, preferably within the building construction industry.
- Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit or similar drafting software.
- Sound understanding of civil and structural engineering principles, construction methods and technical drawing standards.
- Experience preparing detailed drawings for residential, commercial or multi-storey building projects will be highly regarded.
- Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities and organisational skills.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, project managers and construction personnel.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and respond efficiently to changing project requirements.
Benefits
- Competitive salary package commensurate with qualifications and experience.
- Full-time employment with an established construction company.
- Opportunities to work on a diverse range of residential and commercial construction projects.
- A collaborative working environment with experienced construction professionals.
- Opportunities for ongoing professional development and career progression.
About us
Duffy Kennedy Constructions is an established Sydney-based construction company delivering a diverse range of residential, commercial and other building projects. With extensive experience in the construction industry, we are committed to delivering high-quality projects through effective project management, technical expertise and close collaboration between our office and on-site teams. As our construction activities continue to develop, we are strengthening our internal technical capabilities to support efficient project delivery and maintain high standards across our operations.

- Supporting projects through detailed design and delivery

- Strong Civil 3D / 3D modelling skills
- Experience working on civil design for complex buildings or developments
- Solid understanding of drainage, grading, earthworks and civil infrastructure

You'll be joining a great team within a respected Melbourne consultancy, where technical quality, collaboration and professional development are genuinely valued.

WIP Construction is an established Cairns-based commercial construction company delivering projects throughout Cairns and Far North Queensland.
You'll be joining a team where you'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced construction professionals and gain exposure to real commercial projects from tender through to delivery.

You'll be given real work, real responsibility and plenty of support while you develop your skills.

If you're motivated, good with numbers, interested in construction and looking for somewhere to start your career, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply through SEEK with your resume and a short cover letter telling us a little about yourself, what you're currently studying or have completed, and why estimating and commercial construction interests you.

- Provide technical support throughout the project lifecycle, from planning and design through to construction and completion.
Qualifications and Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in civil construction and infrastructure projects.
- Experience in planning, coordinating and overseeing civil engineering and construction works.
- Demonstrated ability to interpret and work from engineering drawings, plans, specifications and construction documentation.
- Experience with project cost estimation, quantity measurement, cost control and budget management.
- Experience assessing design changes and managing variations to project scope, cost and construction methodology.
- Strong knowledge of relevant Australian Standards, construction legislation, quality requirements and workplace health and safety obligations.
